reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000439 (the melody read from 000439a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 22); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Thomas Ravenscroft has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1621, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000439a.nwc).
